98060957.s: The original Armenian taste, offering a wide menu of Armenian dishes.
98060957.b: Tonir offers the original Armenian taste with a wide menu of authentic Armenian dishes such as marinated kebab and eggplant with meat. It has very high ratings for food quality and elegant atmosphere and is a hidden gem worth visiting, although it is relatively far from the city center. Phone: 0537703732. Open from 1:00 pm to 12:00 midnight.

98060956.s: Enjoy a varied menu of delicious dishes in an enchanting atmosphere where luxury meets good taste.
98060956.b: Duma Palace Restaurant lets you enjoy a varied menu of delicious dishes in an enchanting atmosphere where luxury meets good taste in Khamis Mushait. It has exceptional hospitality from its staff and is a trusted destination for family occasions thanks to the quality of its food and warm welcome. Phone: 0537044004. Open from 1:00 pm to 1:00 am.
98060956.a: Imam Muhammad ibn Saud, Khamis Mushait 62432

98060955.s: Serves Arabic food alongside a wide menu of tasty dishes to suit your taste.
98060955.b: Walwang Saraya Khayal serves Arabic food alongside a wide menu of tasty dishes to suit your taste. It is known for tender, expertly marinated meat and refreshing fattoush salad, at reasonable prices and with friendly staff. Phone: 0532425000. Open from 11:30 am to 12:00 midnight.
98060955.a: King Fahd Branch Road, Al Aran, Abha 62528

98060954.s: A contemporary restaurant that blends Turkish, Lebanese and Armenian dishes for a distinctive experience.
98060954.b: Zurna is a contemporary restaurant that blends Turkish, Lebanese and Armenian dishes for a distinctive experience, and is located on the third floor of the Citadines hotel. It is known for cream soup, hummus and chicken tawook, with a free welcome lemon shot and comfortable outdoor seating for smokers and others. Phone: 0543779024. Open from 6:30 am to 10:30 am and from 12:00 pm to 12:00 midnight.
98060954.a: King Fahd Road, Al Mazwin, Abha 62583

98060953.s: A distinctive experience tasting a variety of delicious dishes, desserts and fresh baked goods.
98060953.b: La Scene offers a distinctive experience tasting a variety of delicious dishes, desserts and fresh baked goods, inside Al Jouri Elite complex. It serves varied international dishes in an elegant atmosphere and is the third option in the complex for those looking for more variety in the same location. Phone: 0542773280. Open from 9:00 am to 12:00 midnight.
98060953.a: King Abdulaziz Road, Al Shafa, Abha 65251

98060950.s: A distinctive experience for lovers of luxurious settings, offering a wide menu of innovative dishes.
98060950.b: Le Voyage offers a distinctive experience for lovers of luxurious settings, with a wide menu of innovative dishes such as risotto and a variety of cold appetizers. It is known for its calm, comfortable atmosphere and refined reception, and has excellent reviews as one of the best fine-dining restaurants, although its prices are relatively high. Phone: 0500332559. Open from 1:00 pm to 1:00 am.
98060950.a: King Fahd Road, Al Mazwin, Abha 62582

98060949.s: Offers a variety of distinctive meals in seating overlooking the slopes of Tihamah.
98060949.b: Joy Venue offers a variety of distinctive meals in seating overlooking the slopes of Tihamah, with a stunning view. It provides blankets for cool outdoor seating and has exceptional service and delicious food, making it one of the best places for family celebrations. Phone: 0551956675. Open from 8:00 am to 12:00 midnight.

98060948.s: A restaurant known for its variety of dishes, serving delicious Lebanese food with its unique character.
98060948.b: Aala Bali Cafe is a restaurant known for its variety of dishes, serving delicious Lebanese food with its unique character, and is located in Al Jouri Elite complex with a view over a beautiful garden. It is known for its friendly staff, especially the Filipino team, and is a favorite destination for lovers of authentic Lebanese cuisine. Phone: 0542773278. Open from 7:00 am to 11:30 pm.
98060948.a: King Abdulaziz Road, Al Shafa, Abha 65251

98060946.s: Serves a variety of delicious international dishes amid green spaces and thick fog.
98060946.b: Jorry Elite serves a variety of delicious international dishes amid green spaces and thick fog, with an enchanting elevated view. It is known for its elegant decor and professional staff, and has had excellent reviews as one of the best restaurants in Abha for many years, although its prices are relatively high. Phone: 0542773279. Open from 7:00 am to 11:00 am and from 12:30 pm to 12:00 midnight.
98060946.a: King Abdulaziz Road, Al Shafa, Abha 65251

98060939.s: Traditional local dishes with a distinctive contemporary flavor. Open 24 hours.
98060939.b: Sadaf offers traditional local dishes with a distinctive contemporary flavor, combining an old-world character with a modern touch in an elegant, comfortable atmosphere. It is known for the variety of its dishes and good coffee, and is so popular that booking ahead is advisable to avoid waiting. It is open around the clock on most days of the week.
98060939.a: King Abdulaziz Road, Al Sharafiyah, Abha 62542

98060937.s: Takes you back to an old era of authentic Saudi heritage, serving delicious traditional dishes.
98060937.b: Abha Fort Heritage Restaurant takes you back to an old era of authentic Saudi heritage, serving delicious traditional dishes, and is located next to the historic Abha Fort and the old Ottoman Bridge. It is known for meat soup and rural laban, and gets very crowded in the tourist season, with waits of up to two hours at times, so it is advisable to visit at less busy times. Phone: 0543470968. Open from 7:00 am to 11:00 pm.

98060936.s: A restaurant specializing in traditional food, known for foul in its original flavor and delicious tamees bread.
98060936.b: Layali Abha Restaurant for Traditional Food specializes in traditional dishes and is known for foul in its original flavor and delicious tamees bread. It is known for tasty traditional breakfast dishes and has positive reviews for the quality of its ingredients and its economical prices. Phone: 0537126246. Open from 5:00 am to 12:30 am.
98060936.a: Al Bahrain, Al Sad District, Abha 62521

98060934.s: The pleasure of southern food in all its dimensions: haneeth, mandi, madhbi and different meat and rice dishes.
98060934.b: Ali Ramzi Restaurant offers the pleasure of southern food in all its dimensions, with haneeth, mandi, madhbi and different meat and rice dishes. It is known for tender haneeth meat with an authentic flavor, and is fairly popular, although some visitors note that the waiting line needs better organization. Phone: 0556603335. Open from 12:00 pm to 10:30 pm.
98060934.a: King Saud Street, west of Al Ahli Bank, Al Miftaha, Abha 62521

98060933.s: A destination for lovers of traditional breakfast dishes prepared in the traditional way with a heritage character.
98060933.b: Al Areesh is a destination for lovers of traditional breakfast dishes prepared in the traditional way with a heritage character, and is one of the few restaurants in the area open in the morning. It is known for foul, Adeni shakshuka and kabsa, and offers rich Ramadan iftar meals during the holy month. Open from 6:00 am to 3:00 pm.
98060933.a: King Abdulaziz Road, Al Miftaha, Abha 62521

98060932.s: A heritage experience among rich and varied traditional dishes in a style full of the fragrance of the past.
98060932.b: Al Majlis Al Khaleeji offers a heritage experience among rich and varied traditional dishes in a style full of the fragrance of the past. It serves authentic Gulf dishes such as maqluba and majboos, with decor that reflects traditional hospitality. Phone: 920009533. Open from 6:00 am to 12:00 midnight.

98060930.s: A restaurant offering haneeth, madhbi, madghoot and a variety of tasty side dishes and appetizers.
98060930.b: Haneeth Mala offers haneeth, madhbi, madghoot and a variety of tasty side dishes and appetizers. It is known for haneeth lamb and chicken served with Peshawari rice and assorted salads, and operates mainly on a takeaway basis. Phone: 0535513666. Open from 12:30 pm to 12:30 am.

98060929.s: Authentic Saudi cuisine, from mathlutha and jareesh to marqooq and maqluba.
98060929.b: Bab Al Turath serves authentic Saudi cuisine, from mathlutha and jareesh to marqooq and maqluba, with heritage decor that includes traditional floor-seating booths. It is known for rice dishes generous in quantity and quality, and has fast service that makes it a trusted place to experience authentic Saudi cuisine. Phone: 0552281500. Open from 11:30 am to 11:30 pm.
98060929.a: King Abdulaziz Road, Al Miftaha, Abha 62521

98060898.s: A quiet view over Abha's ring road with a choice of cafes and restaurants.
98060898.b: Shurfa Boulevard complex offers a quiet view over Abha's ring road, with a choice of cafes and restaurants. It is a pleasant place to meet friends and have coffee, although some shops need improvements such as adding fitting rooms. It is a simple, comfortable option for a break while exploring the city.
98060898.a: King Abdulaziz Road, New Abha, Abha 62512

98060895.s: Enjoy a pleasant shopping outing with your family, with many restaurants, cafes and fresh bakeries.
98060895.b: Garden Square lets you enjoy a pleasant shopping outing with your family, with many options for restaurants, cafes and fresh baked goods. It is located on the ring road and brings together elegant small restaurant spaces, although some visitors note limited parking and high prices in some shops. Open from 6:00 am to 12:30 am.

98060894.s: Includes many different cafes and distinctive restaurants, along with a supermarket and some brands.
98060894.b: Rafala Plaza includes many different cafes and distinctive restaurants, alongside a supermarket and some brands, to be your ideal destination. It has a Danube supermarket and a Gold's Gym fitness hall, along with varied restaurants such as Asl Al Burger and Baskin Robbins. Phone: 0554930949. Open from 7:00 am to 1:00 am.
98060894.a: King Fahd Road, Al Aran, Abha 62528

98060892.s: Enjoy a pleasant shopping outing with your family, with many shopping options and Gulf restaurants.
98060892.b: Al Ghoneim Square lets you enjoy a pleasant shopping outing with your family, with many shopping options and Gulf restaurants. It has a variety of shops such as Adidas and a supermarket with daily fresh produce, along with reasonable prices and a friendly reception staff, making it a practical place for everyday shopping in Khamis Mushait. Open from 8:00 am to 12:00 midnight.

98060891.s: The smell of coffee fills the place in a complex with the most famous international coffee brands.
98060891.b: Abha Coffee Land greets you with a strong smell of coffee in a complex that holds the most famous international coffee brands such as Starbucks and Dunkin' Donuts, alongside local cafes. It has lovely outdoor seating (a terrace) for each cafe and sees heavy evening traffic, which sometimes makes parking crowded.

98060889.s: Modern buildings with up-to-date designs, with several Saudi-run restaurants and a variety of cafes.
98060889.b: Abha Park has modern buildings with the latest designs, with several Saudi-run restaurants and a variety of cafes such as the famous Butter Bakery. The place is decorated with a dancing fountain that moves to the rhythm of music, along with an indoor play area for children, and has a wonderful atmosphere that brings families and friends together. Phone: 0598068684. Open 24 hours.

98060888.s: A distinctive site overlooking the road linking Abha and Khamis Mushait, with many restaurants, cafes and pet shops.
98060888.b: Abha View is a distinctive site overlooking the road linking Abha and Khamis Mushait, with many restaurants, cafes and pet shops. It is a popular summer destination where visitors come to enjoy the views and the cool weather, and is very popular as one of the best leisure places in the region. Open from 7:00 am to 2:00 am.
98060888.a: 6407 King Fahd Branch Road, Al Mahalah, Abha 62561

98060854.s: An old traditional market with many shops selling furnishings, as well as ceramics and pottery.
98060854.b: Souq Al Aqabah is an old traditional market with many shops selling furnishings, as well as ceramics and pottery. The number of open shops has fallen over time, but it still keeps its traditional character and a few shops offering fair prices for household needs. Phone: 0534963800.
